rationale: Replace CARMA's stale signed-pending narrative with the completed December 2025 acquisition. CVC DIF remains the current owner through DIF Infrastructure VIII and the disclosed acquisition vehicle is DIF Infra 8 Canada Holdco 2 Ltd. TerraNova's former control and exit are preserved in sourced description and milestone history; no ownership-period row is created because the production organization dependency does not exist. The exact closing day, acquired percentage and rollover are not publicly disclosed and are not inferred.

beforeImage.name: CARMA Corp.
beforeImage.description: CARMA provides submetering, utility billing, and essential building services for multi-residential and commercial properties in Canada. Its customers are building owners, managers, and residents that require consumption measurement, billing administration, and related services tied to utility infrastructure. The platform is infrastructure-linked and recurring because it depends on installed metering assets, contracted service relationships, and long-duration building exposure. CVC DIF announced in 2025 that CARMA operated across more than 1,000 buildings and approximately 135,000 units in Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia. CVC DIF also stated that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire CARMA through DIF Infrastructure VIII, and public sources reviewed do not disclose the post-closing ownership structure.

afterImage.name: CARMA Corp.
afterImage.description: CARMA Corp. provides utility submetering, billing, collections, consumption reporting and on-site technical services for multi-residential, commercial and institutional properties. The company traces its predecessor operations to 1977 and was formed as CARMA Corp. through the August 2019 amalgamation of Carma Industries Inc. and Carma Billing Services Inc. CVC DIF agreed to acquire CARMA from TerraNova through DIF Infrastructure VIII on September 15, 2025, and industry-association reporting confirms the sale closed in December 2025. The disclosed acquisition vehicle is DIF Infra 8 Canada Holdco 2 Ltd.; the exact closing day, acquired stake and any management or family rollover are not publicly disclosed. CARMA operated more than 135,000 units across more than 1,000 buildings at signing and was reported to have approximately 350,000 meters installed across North America by June 2026. Spectrum, Priority Submetering, Undercurrent and Greensource remain operating businesses beneath CARMA rather than separate manager-level PortCos. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
